title: Login selector for Mahidol local-part and Username without changing authentication
changes: Show Mahidol email and Username choice on the existing login form.
Mahidol mode accepts only the local part, visually appends @mahidol.ac.th, and accepts pasted full Mahidol emails.
Username mode preserves existing username lookup; existing password handling and Supabase Auth remain unchanged.
Do not change Staff/Admin roles, OT, HR, schedules, or database state.
notes: Update files to the repository root. Only this login UI and input normalization changed.
